title: mTreeCuter
description: mTreeCuter is an elegant, modern, and highly configurable tree-cutting (timber) plugin for Paper 1.21+.
body:
# mTreeCuter 🪓

**mTreeCuter** is a robust and lightweight Minecraft plugin for Paper 1.21.11 that drastically simplifies woodcutting. By breaking a single block, players can chop down entire trees instantly! It brings an immersive dynamic feeling to vanilla Minecraft while remaining highly configurable to suit the needs of any server.
## ✨ Features
- **Instant Tree Chopping**: Break one log block to bring down an entire tree.
- **Shift-Mining Option**: Force players to hold `Sneak` (Shift) to activate the tree-cutting mechanic.
- **Immersive Effects**: 
  - **Glowing Blocks**: The tree log blocks briefly glow when chopped, visually highlighting the entire tree structure. Configurable colors per wood type (e.g., gold for Nether woods, aqua for Overworld woods).
  - **Mining Animations & Particles**: Provides satisfying visual feedback when trees fall down.
- **Fast Leaf Decay**: Automatically speed up leaf decay when a tree is cut down.
- **Smart Item Drops**: Optionally send dropped wood logs, saplings, and apples directly to the player's inventory to reduce ground lag.
- **Auto-Plant Saplings**: Automatically detect falling saplings and replant them on valid ground blocks securely.
- **Disabled Worlds Limits**: Globally disable the tree-cutting feature in specific worlds (like Hubs or mini-game maps).
- **Custom Actions System**: Execute specific server commands based on the type of tree chopped and the quantity of logs broken (e.g., giving monetary rewards or custom messages).
- **PlaceholderAPI Support**: Full integration with `%mtreecuter_toggle%` to display whether the player has the feature on or off.
- **Per-Wood Types Configuration**: Fully customizable tools and block types for normal logs (Overworld) and Nether stems. Even supports the newest woods like Pale Oak and Cherry!
## ⚙️ Commands & Permissions
- `/mtreecuter toggle` – Enable/disable the tree-cutting ability personally for a player.
- `/mtreecuter reload` – Reloads the `config.yml` on the fly.
### Permissions
- `treecuter.use` – Permission granted to players to allow them to cut down whole trees (if `use-permissions` is enabled in the config).
- *Admin permissions apply for `/mtreecuter reload`.*
## 🛠️ Configuration
The plugin offers extensive customization in the `config.yml` file. You can easily configure:
- Minimum blocks to qualify as a "tree" to cut.
- Maximum block limits to prevent server lag on giant custom trees.
- Allowed tools (Wooden Axe up to Netherite Axe).
- Custom accepted leaves algorithms (including Shroomlights and Nether Warts).
- Translation and formatting of all UI messages.
